note: Every output event is one granular step with one action. PlayHand/DiscardHand are decomposed into SelectCard micro-steps plus commit; UseConsumable/SelectPackItem/BuyAndUseShopConsumable are conditionally decomposed based on target class_id; SWAP_i_j steps are synthesized from joker-order changes between boundary events.

step_fields.action: str — flattened action label (e.g. PlayHand, BuyShopItem_2, SWAP_1_3)
step_fields.action_subtype: null | string — parsed subtype from action_details (e.g. buyvoucher)
step_fields.micro_index: int — index within decomposed source event (negative for pre-action synthesized swaps)
step_fields.zones: object — canonical zone snapshots for downstream masking/tensorization
step_fields.selected_cards: optional [object] — already selected cards in sequence
step_fields.current_hand_or_pack: optional [object] — dynamic pool during selection micro-steps

card_object_fields.card: null | {rank, rank_index, suit, suit_index, is_ace, is_face}
card_object_fields.edition: null | str — e_foil | e_holo | e_negative | e_polychrome
card_object_fields.modifier: null | str — m_bonus | m_glass | m_gold | m_lucky | m_mult | m_steel | m_stone | m_wild
card_object_fields.seal: null | str — blue_seal | gold_seal | purple_seal | red_seal
